# Hermes Agent: Onboarding & Troubleshooting FAQ

---

### General & User Interfaces

#### Does Hermes Agent support a Web UI, or is it CLI-only?
Hermes includes a first-party web dashboard. Run `hermes dashboard` to start a local server at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`. The **Chat** tab embeds the full Hermes interface directly in your browser.

#### Is native Windows supported without WSL2?
Yes. Windows 10/11 is a Tier 1 supported platform using the official PowerShell installer (`install.ps1`). *Note:* WSL2 is still recommended if you use the embedded terminal chat in the Web Dashboard, which requires a POSIX PTY.

#### Can Hermes run on ARM64 architectures (e.g., Raspberry Pi 4B)?
Yes. `scripts/install.sh` supports `aarch64`/`arm64`/`armv7l`. Node bootstrapping and Python dependencies supply ARM64 wheels or are pure Python.

---

### Task Execution, Goals, & Sessions

#### What is the tool-call limit, and what happens when it is reached?
To avoid runaway loops, conversation turns cap tool executions via `agent.max_turns` (default: 90). You can override this per turn with `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`. When reached, Hermes wraps up with a final non-tool response rather than silently failing.

#### How do I run long autonomous tasks across multiple turns?
Use the `/goal` command (Ralph loop). It persists across turns and pauses gracefully if budget is met. You can resume at any time via `/goal resume` or `/resume`.

#### Why did my Telegram/gateway session reset?
Modern releases use `resume_pending` to preserve IDs and transcripts through restarts/crashes, and `session_reset` defaults to `mode: none` (auto-reset is opt-in). Use `/resume` to restore past sessions. Forced resets only trigger during stuck restart loops.

---

### Providers & Authentication

#### How do I use Claude Pro/Max subscription usage instead of API billing?
You must authenticate via **OAuth**. Providing a direct Anthropic API key routes requests to standard per-token API billing, regardless of your personal subscription status.

#### Can I connect to Microsoft Azure AI Foundry?
Yes. Configure via `hermes setup` or set `provider: azure-foundry`. It auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` (legacy Claude Code env vars are ignored). For custom endpoints, query parameters like `?api-version=...` are preserved automatically.

#### How do I configure Google Gemini?
Gemini CLI OAuth and `google-antigravity` flows have been deprecated. Use Google AI Studio via `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`, or connect via Vertex AI.

#### Why was I charged for DeepSeek Pro instead of Flash?
Model normalization maps `deepseek-chat` to current provider equivalents. Ensure you are on the latest version where canonical models like `deepseek-v4-flash` pass through without alias rewrites.

---

### Gateway & Multi-Agent Configurations

#### Can Discord bots read uploaded code/text files?
Yes. Authorized uploads (including `.py`, `.txt`, and general attachments) are cached and injected directly into the agent’s context.

#### How do I configure subagents and multi-agent communication?
Use the built-in `delegate_task` tool. It creates isolated child subagents with their own contexts and terminal sessions (default up to 3 concurrent instances).

#### Can I set different personas per channel?
Yes. Define the `channel_prompts` configuration key to inject ephemeral system prompts per channel/group ID across Discord, Telegram, Slack, and Mattermost.

#### How do I run isolated instances or multiple accounts (e.g., WeChat/Telegram)?
* **Profiles (Recommended):** Use `hermes profile create <name>` and `hermes profile use <name>` (or `HERMES_PROFILE=<name>`). Profiles isolate `config.yaml`, `SOUL.md`, memory, and credentials. A single gateway can multiplex across profiles without collision.
* **Hermes Home:** Set `HERMES_HOME=~/.hermes-<name>` to keep directories completely independent.

---

### Customization, Memory, & Maintenance

#### How do I create and register custom tools?
The supported method is writing a plugin in `~/.hermes/plugins` using `ctx.register_tool(...)` and enabling it via `hermes plugins enable <name>`. (For core development, tools reside in `tools/<name>.py` and must be exposed in `toolsets.py`).

#### How do `SOUL.md`, `MEMORY.md`, and `USER.md` differ?
* `SOUL.md`: Configures the agent's core identity and persona.
* `MEMORY.md`: Stores learned facts and scratchpad data.
* `USER.md`: Stores persistent profile details and user preferences (accessed via `target="user"`).

#### Why does `hermes update` pause on Node.js dependencies?
The update process downloads Camofox browser binaries during the postinstall phase without showing immediate progress output. It has not hung; allow it time to complete.
